SECTION 1. Title 17 of the Municipal Code of Chicago, the Chicago Zoning Ordinance, is hereby

amended by changing the RS-3 Residential Single-Unit (Detached House) District symbols and
indications as shown on Map No. 6-F in the area bounded by

       A line 74 feet south of and parallel to West 30*^ Street; South Wells Street; A line 99 feet south of
       and parallel to West 30* Street; and the public alley next west of and parallel to South Wells Street.

to those of a RT-4 Two-Flat, Townhouse, and Multi-Unit District.


SECTION 2. This ordinance shall be in force and effect from and after its passage and due publication.
